arguments.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Please treat the gas smell as serious, even if it only happens sometimes. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't touch light switches or use any flame. Open the windows, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). If you ever feel unwell or are in immediate danger, call 999. We are arranging a Gas Safe registered engineer as an emergency and will update you today. We'll also look into the oven not heating properly once the gas check is done. Please don't go back in until you've been told it's safe.
